title: Enroll with your organization: the app's enrollment through the browser, end to end
spec: The enrollment screen has 'Enroll with your organization', which needs only the link (Action::EnrollExternal; the form is cleared), shows the wait for the browser with Cancel (Action::CancelSignIn), and any answer ends the wait. Controller::set_browser sets the browser for enrollments and later sign-ins. Enrollment::start_external runs enroll_client::enroll_external over a bootstrap connection opened with up to MAX_EXTERNAL_CONFIRMATION_WINDOW: RedeemExternal, external_flow::browse (WaitingForBrowser; cancel or drop ends it), ConfirmExternal, Activated, the chain verified. ERR_WRONG_PATH is EnrollmentError::WrongPath on either path; the app's words say which way the server enrolls, that a refused confirmation did not match the invitation, and why the browser failed. A server with identity.toml keeps bootstrap connections up to EXTERNAL_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT. End to end against a running server: a password enrollment is refused with words that say so; an enrollment whose provider identity carries another email is refused and leaves that invitation live; a person enrolls with only the link and the browser (no authenticator setup), signs in through the provider, and posts; the store holds them bound to the provider identity with no password.
